## File: settings-paths-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Menu for managing default folder paths (canonical, project,
## and workspace roots) referenced by settings and tooling.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.settings.paths
  name: "Settings > Paths Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Submenu for default folder path configuration."

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.paths.canonical-folder"
    label: "Canonical Folder"
    description: "Set the root folder for canonical registry schemas and manifests."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    args:
      key_value: "canonical_folder"
      pick_mode: "folder"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.paths.project-root"
    label: "Project Root"
    description: "Set the root folder for the active Prismata project."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    args:
      key_value: "project_root"
      pick_mode: "folder"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.paths.workspace-root"
    label: "Workspace Root"
    description: "Set the Universe workspace directory (state, ingestion, registry, archive)."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    args:
      key_value: "workspace_root"
      pick_mode: "folder"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "4"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.paths.temp-folder"
    label: "Temp Folder"
    description: "Set the temporary working directory for intermediate outputs."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-paths"
    args:
      key_value: "temp_folder"
      pick_mode: "folder"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
